'''Dura-armor'''<ref name="GSWU" /> or '''DuraArmour'''<ref name="GBG">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> was an incredibly durable, industrial-strength material that was capable of absorbing and re-directing [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] energy away from it. Consisting of the substances [[Neutronium/Legends|neutronium]], [[Lommite/Legends|lommite]] and [[Zersium/Legends|zersium]], all set in a specific matrix,<ref name="GSWU" /> dura-armor could be used to construct [[Shield (physical armor)/Legends|shields]],<ref name="HSE" /> [[Armor/Legends|armor]],<ref name="TotJC" /> and [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]].<ref name="CM" />

During the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] surrounding the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Core World Arms]] used dura-armor to manufacture impact-resistant molded armor. Each suit cost 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and protected the wearer from crashes and falls.<ref name="TotJC" />

The [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] [[BLX-5|Bollux]] was equipped with a dura-armor shield for his [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat against a [[Mark X Executioner droid/Legends|Mark X Executioner]] at the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] facility.<ref name="HSE" /> During combat on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kestos Minor/Legends|Kestos Minor]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] [[Modigal Glave]]'s helmet was shattered by a point-blank blaster shot which sent fragments of dura-armor into his face, scarring him on the right side. Glave single-handedly fended off a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] until [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] arrived despite the pain.<ref name="CM" />

==Behind the scenes==
"DuraArmour" (as it is spelled in the manual) is a game mechanic stat in the strategy game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. This stat, possessed by each unit and building, defines protection from long-range attacks.
